record.oneLiner: Developer platform whose REST API lets scripts and applications automate and extend GitHub, with each endpoint documented individually.
record.verdictReason: Personal access tokens and OAuth apps are self-serve, and the docs state no review step for OAuth apps. GitHub publishes an official MCP server with a hosted remote endpoint.

evidence.quote: You can also create an OAuth token with an OAuth app to access the REST API.
If you want to use the GitHub REST API for personal use, you can create a personal access token.
Each REST API endpoint is documented individually
